falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low equivalent invalidates the bottom pattern match; the 77% similarity to bottom_2024_aug requires holding above that structural support, and losing it proves this was not a bottom formation but a breakdown continuation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 suggests controlled fear; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation rather than blowoff capitulation, meaning the pattern is a failed bottom and the market is entering a higher-volatility regime inconsistent with the HOLD signal

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below its 20-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination signals flight-to-safety recession pricing rather than growth-bottoming; it invalidates the macro bottom thesis by showing rates and equities both falling together, indicating deflationary scare rather than the reflationary bottom pattern of August 2024

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
